statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the smallest nonnegative integer m for which there exist an integer s and an array b of length n such that: (1) 1 ≤ b[j] ≤ limit for every j with 0 ≤ j < n; (2) b[i] + b[n-1-i] = s for every i with 0 ≤ i < n; and (3) m equals the number of indices j with 0 ≤ j < n for which b[j] ≠ nums[j].
